sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Eman El henawey and revised by maintenance 
general director eng. Wageh Khalil revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Abel El Naggar 
accepted by eng. Ali Zahran general manager approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head 
sector of Nubaria power station and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageb inspection 
and quality head sector.

Safety 
Precautions

A work permit must be 
issued the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area

Wear 
appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, helmet 
breathing mask, safety glasses

The 
circuit breaker should be switched off

sections.text: Tools and Equipments

items: Tester (digital Avometer)
Set off spanners and screw drivers
Lubricate oil or grease suitable for each part
Vacuum cleaner

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Check 
oil amount gears and retiring
Lubricate brakes arm
Check brake setting
Check the coupling
Check any abnormal sound or smell

Check he primary and secondary shaft 
bearings and replacement, if necessary

Check the bed plate of hoisting machine 
and insulator
Check speed regulator
Check ropes condition and ropes paths
Check control panel
Check gear tolerance
Check lighting lamps and air fan
